title: Thaddeus Meeting 1

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Good, you're here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good, you're here.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: How'd you like to be a business owner, kid?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How'd you like to be a business owner, kid?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Well, it's your lucky day. This old place, it's yours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, it's your lucky day. This old place, it's yours.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Don't put yourself down. You got potential. And I'm giving you a chance to use it. This old place, it's yours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't put yourself down. You got potential. And I'm giving you a chance to use it. This old place, it's yours.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: The noodle bar. It's yours. I'm giving it to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The noodle bar. It's yours. I'm giving it to you.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: I got... some things I need to do. Somewhere else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got... some things I need to do. Somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: No time like the present. And at present, I gotta be somewhere else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No time like the present. And at present, I gotta be somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: I don't think there's a word for the situation I'm in. But that's not your problem. You got this place to think about now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think there's a word for the situation I'm in. But that's not your problem. You got this place to think about now.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Banor will show you the ropes. That old goat knows this place better than anyone. And Ava... listen to her. She can't come with me where I'm going.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Banor will show you the ropes. That old goat knows this place better than anyone. And Ava... listen to her. She can't come with me where I'm going.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Just... away. And soon. But before I go, you wanna piece of advice?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just... away. And soon. But before I go, you wanna piece of advice?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Every day in Nivalis, you have to make a choice. You gotta lift people up, or you gotta step on them. Won't always be a matter of right and wrong. But you gotta choose. That's all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Every day in Nivalis, you have to make a choice. You gotta lift people up, or you gotta step on them. Won't always be a matter of right and wrong. But you gotta choose. That's all.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Your loss. Take care Kid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your loss. Take care Kid.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: You will. One day. Maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You will. One day. Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Gone, kid. I'm already gone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gone, kid. I'm already gone.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: I know you young folks can run late, but I'm not going to live forever you know. We have work to do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know you young folks can run late, but I'm not going to live forever you know. We have work to do.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: By all means, take your time. It's not like we have a business to run.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: By all means, take your time. It's not like we have a business to run.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's so urgent?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's so urgent?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Always dreamed of being an entrepreneur.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Always dreamed of being an entrepreneur.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Always dreamed of being an entrepreneur.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Always dreamed of being an entrepreneur.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds a lot like hard work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds a lot like hard work.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds a lot like hard work.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds a lot like hard work.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What? Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just like that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just like that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you in some kind of trouble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you in some kind of trouble?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you in some kind of trouble?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you in some kind of trouble?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know anything about running a restaurant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know anything about running a restaurant.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't know anything about running a restaurant.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't know anything about running a restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where are you going?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're going now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're going now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nope.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.
